title: Jango Fett
subtitle: Guarding the Count
text:
While an enemy unit has attacked your base this phase, this unit gains Ambush. (When you play this unit, he may attack an enemy unit.)
On Attack: Give an enemy unit –3/–0 for this phase.
rules:
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. The unit does not have to be ready in order to attack.
An enemy unit has attacked your base if it has declared an attack against your base, regardless of if your base was damaged.
